title: Mortgage Rates Hit 7.4%. It's Not the Fed
text:
Lenders price 30-year mortgages off the 10-year Treasury yield plus a margin. That yield hit about 5.36% in October, its highest since 2002, and the 30-year average reached 7.40% (Freddie Mac, Oct 15).
